title: Halloween at the Pond — Stickers
subtitle: PRINT THEM YOURSELF
licence: For your own personal use — print them as many times as you like, for yourself and your household. Please don't resell, redistribute, or share the file itself. © Frog Logic

sheets.label: HALLOWEEN 2026
sheets.intro: The four Halloween frogs as stickers, two of each, to print at home. Sticker paper from any stationers works, and so does ordinary paper with a glue stick. Cut along the dashed lines — or round the corners, which makes them last longer on a water bottle.
sheets.note: PRINT AT 100% · DO NOT SCALE TO FIT · EACH SQUARE IS 54 × 54 MM
